body:
I also take mood meds from the doctor.
I've been smoking weed for 2 and a half years and this is what I have to report. I quit mainly because every once and a while I'd get what me and my friends called Bad weed. Bad weed is the weed that gives me a headache makes me paranoid (thoughts of dying going crazy) and just isn't fun. I'd say about 1 in 5 bags of weed I've gotten in Western Michigan could be called Bad weed for a number of reasons even such as low potency or high tendency to cause paranoia. I think it relates to the THC/CBD/THVC ratios in them and possibly to some extent set and setting and psychological disposition. To make a metaphor if you had an orgasm and 1 in every 5 orgasms was painful you'd probaly quit fucking till you find a solution.
Well my only solution is to grow myself and at this time I dont have that option. I quit on August 14th of 2007 cause I got the worst bag of weed in my life it caused me to feel actual severe physical pain. I was not actually in physical pain but the waves in my brain that signal that kinda pain were going off. This weed was just weed not cut with anything it was just shit weed. To this I say everyone grow you own take the profit out of it. Or if the government ever controls and regulates for purity (that'll be the day) then I might use again.
